name: Peter Bala
evidence: Across dozens of self-authored OEIS-hosted papers (2009-2016+) he lists no institutional affiliation, only a personal email pbala@talktalk.net (UK residential consumer ISP); his OEIS wiki page states only interests, and an arXiv paper proving one of his conjectures credits him only as an OEIS contributor.

name: Thomas Ordowski
evidence: Prolific poser of number-theory conjectures on OEIS/NMBRTHRY/SeqFan since ~2012; professional mathematicians study his conjectures as an outside source (Elsholtz & Harman, 'On conjectures of T. Ordowski and Z.W. Sun...'); no academic publications, degrees, or employer found under his name. A same-named IT professional on LinkedIn could not be tied to OEIS (possible name collision, not counted).

name: Alex Ratushnyak
occupation: Independent researcher and consultant (data compression / computer science)
evidence: Same person as Alexander Rhatushnyak, four-time Hutter Prize winner (PAQ-based compressors, 2006-2017); his about.me page describes him as 'Researcher and Consultant' in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario, PhD in computer science, no university affiliation; contributed to the JPEG-XL standard as an industry contributor.

name: Charles R Greathouse IV
affiliation: NYSTEC (New York State Technology Enterprise Corporation), Albany, NY
evidence: His GitHub profile (the account hosting his PARI/GP and OEIS-related repositories) lists Senior Consultant at NYSTEC, a nonprofit technology consulting firm; his research profile is on the 'independent' subdomain of academia.edu and no academic affiliation was found. OEIS editorship is volunteer.

name: Jianing Song
evidence: OEIS contributions (active ~2018-2024) contain only mathematical content; extensive searches found no personal site or profile linkable to this OEIS account. A same-named ResearchGate postdoc (navigation/Kalman filtering) is an unrelated name collision.

name: Paul D. Hanna
evidence: Alan D. Sokal's peer-reviewed paper 'The Euler and Springer numbers as moment sequences' (Expositiones Mathematicae, 2018) explicitly refers to him as 'an amateur mathematician, Paul D. Hanna' who contributed a continued fraction to OEIS A000111; Sokal thanks him for direct correspondence, confirming the same person.

name: Rémy Sigrist
evidence: OEIS wiki bio states only lifelong interest in mathematics and computing; his co-authored arXiv papers list no academic affiliation for him; extensive English/French searches found no confirmed professional or academic profile tied to this person.

name: Amarnath Murthy
affiliation: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd (ONGC), India
evidence: B.E. in Electronics & Telecommunications (Maulana Azad College of Technology, Bhopal, 1982); worked as DGM (E&T) at ONGC per his own CV; pursued number theory (Smarandache notions) outside his engineering career, publishing 125+ papers and 4900+ OEIS sequences.

name: Gus Wiseman
evidence: OEIS wiki bio: 'formerly a student of pure mathematics at University of California, Davis', no current academic position; his Quora profile self-describes as 'mainly a teacher of advanced mathematics and an advocate for severe mental illness', consistent with an independent researcher.

name: Reinhard Zumkeller
occupation: Self-employed IT/business consultant (Zumkeller Beratung GmbH); Dr. rer. nat. in computer science (TU Dortmund, 1976)
evidence: His 2015 Journal of Integer Sequences paper lists a personal Munich address (vs co-authors' institutional affiliations); German business-register results show 'Dr. Zumkeller, Reinhard' as liquidator of Zumkeller Beratung GmbH at that same address; doctorate in Informatik (TU Dortmund, 1976, advisor Volker Claus) with no evidence of a subsequent academic post.

name: Mohammed Bouras
evidence: 'Mohammed Bouras from Morocco' (Romanian Mathematical Magazine bio note); across his EasyChair preprint, arXiv math.GM paper, and viXra preprints, no institutional affiliation is ever listed, only a personal Gmail; publishes exclusively in low-barrier venues typical of independent number theorists.

name: Amiram Eldar
evidence: Ph.D. in Physics, Hebrew University of Jerusalem (2000, thesis 'Methods for analysis of cosmic flows'); co-authored cosmology papers around 2000-2002; no publications, faculty listing, or employer found after ~2002; prolific OEIS contributions since ~2017 show no institutional affiliation, suggesting independent enthusiast.

name: Lorenzo Sauras Altuzarra
occupation: Postdoctoral researcher in logic and number theory
affiliation: Research Unit of Computational Logic, TU Wien
evidence: PhD in Mathematics (2024, TU Wien, supervised by M. Baaz); MSc from University of Vienna; peer-reviewed publications (The Ramanujan Journal, Journal of Logic and Computation) listing TU Wien / Kurt Gödel Society affiliations.

name: Eva-Maria Zschorn
evidence: ~35 OEIS contributions in a burst Nov 2009 - May 2010; cited references are popular/recreational number-theory works (Ribenboim, Derbyshire, German puzzle books) with no academic papers or affiliation; email domain is a small Saxony ISP; no wiki page or biographical record found.

name: Jonathan Sondow
occupation: Mathematician (former university lecturer; later independent researcher in number theory)
affiliation: Formerly Courant Institute (NYU), CUNY, Rice University, Yeshiva University; later unaffiliated (New York, NY)
evidence: Ph.D. in mathematics from Princeton (1965); taught at Courant Institute (NYU), CUNY, Rice, and Yeshiva per his obituary; later arXiv papers list only his personal Manhattan address, indicating independent research until his death in 2020.
